# Create Calendar Event

**Provider:** [Google Workspace](../index)

Creates a Google Calendar event with summary, start and end times, optional
attendees, location, description, timezone, and Google Meet conference data.
A dry-run mode validates and returns the event payload without writing.

## Command Path

google-workspace, create-calendar-event

## Categories

calendar, scheduling

## Aliases

schedule meeting, create google calendar event, add calendar event

## Provider Parameters

bearer_token, gmail_base_url, calendar_base_url

## Input Parameters

attendees, calendar_id, create_meet, description, dry_run, end, location, start, summary, timezone

## Output Fields

dry_run, event, html_link, id, status

## Input Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  calendar_id:
    type: string
    description: Calendar identifier. Use "primary" for the authenticated user's primary calendar.
  summary:
    type: string
    description: Event title.
  description:
    type: string
    description: Optional event description.
  location:
    type: string
    description: Optional event location.
  start:
    type: string
    description: RFC3339 start datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.
  end:
    type: string
    description: RFC3339 end datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.
  timezone:
    type: string
    description: IANA timezone for date-time events, such as America/New_York.
  attendees:
    type: array
    description: Attendee email addresses. CLI accepts comma-separated values.
    items:
      type: string
  create_meet:
    type: boolean
    description: Request Google Meet conference data.
  dry_run:
    type: boolean
    description: Build and validate the event payload without creating it.
required:
  - summary
  - start
  - end
```

## Output Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  id:
    type: string
    description: Created Google Calendar event id.
  html_link:
    type: string
    description: Browser URL for the event.
  status:
    type: string
    description: Event status returned by Google Calendar.
  dry_run:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether the event was only built and not created.
  event:
    type: object
    description: Event payload for dry-run responses.
```
